content.title: 2026 Masters Par 3 Contest: Winner, aces and what the players said
content.text: Updated April 8, 2026, 5:34 p.m. ETAs golfers prepare for the grind, nerves and pressure of the Masters Tournament, the day before the event at Augusta National is a chance to relax.After a shortened morning practice round, Masters participants had the chance to compete in the Par 3 Contest on Wednesday afternoon.Players brought friends, family and a handful of celebrities onto the tees and greens, letting them be along for the ride around the Par 3 Course. Dozens of children in custom-made caddie bibs, plenty of laughs and some very good golf shots were had.We'll update this story throughout the afternoon with the highlight moments from the Par 3 Contest, as well as our favorite photos on the day.Click here to find the full list of tee times later down in this story.Who won the 2026 Masters Par 3 Contest?Aaron Rai claimed the Par 3 Contest crown with a score of 6-under-par 21. His birdie on hole No. 9 gave him a lead that he would not relinquish.What Players Were Saying After The Par 3 ContestScottie Scheffler on the importance of the Par 3 one day before the first round of the Masters:"It's really nice. I think major championships can be stressful as you prepare for them, and having an afternoon like this where you can come out and relax and have some fun with my family is really nice."Justin Thomas echoed a similar sentiment, particular as it pertains to the mental marathon that can be the Masters:"I mean, mentally it's great, right? It's probably the least stressed, the most relaxed we'll be on a golf course. It's depending on what guys are doing, either practice before or maybe do something after or vice versa. But it's nice to be on the golf course, on the grounds of Augusta National and not be stressed about where the ball is going to go or it being overly difficult. It's just nothing but fun out here."Andrew Novak, who brought his 5-month-old daughter onto the course with him, was excited about the memories that they'll share at this event:"Hopefully we do this for a long time. Hopefully this is an annual thing. Yeah, it was great having her here today, but it'll be great when she's walking, crawling, whatever. Yeah. This is just a special day. It's so fun to get to do this." How many holes in one occurred at the Masters Par 3 Contest?In all, four players made an ace on Wednesay afternoon, resulting in a pair of crystal glasses for each.No. 2: Justin Thomas. It's his second ace in the Par 3 Contest. The last came in 2016.No. 4: Tommy Fleetwood. He's the first English player with an ace since Matt Wallace in 2019.No. 7: Wyndham Clark. It's the first ace on No. 7 since Ben Crenshaw in 2013.No. 8: Keegan Bradley. Bradley and Clark were playing in the same group. It's also the second year in a row Bradley has had an ace in the event.2026 Par 3 Contest Closest to the Pin LeadersNo. 1: Mark O'Meara, 3 feet, 8 inchesNo. 2: Justin Thomas, aceNo. 3: J.J. Spaun, 7 inchesNo. 4: Tommy Fleetwood, aceNo. 5: Dustin Johnson, 2 feet, 2 inchesNo. 6: Sam Burns, 2.8 inchesNo. 7: Wyndham Clark, aceNo. 8: Keegan Bradley, aceNo. 9: Mark O'Meara, 1 foot, 7.5 inches2026 Masters Par 3 Contest Live Updates 3:23 p.m.: Ace No. 4 arrives, and we have a new leader at Masters Par 3 ContestTommy Fleetwood joins the party with a hole in one on No. 4, which hadn't had many close shots all day. It's the fourth ace of the Par 3 Contest.Earlier, Jacob Bridgeman's share of the lead was short-lived on Wednesday afternoon.Aaron Rai completed a round of 6-under-par 21 with a birdie on No. 9 to take the lead by himself. He was also shown up again on the final hole by his girlfriend Gaurika Bishnoi, who put beat all the pros in that group with the closest shot to the pin.It's no fluke, either. She's a member of the Ladies European Tour. 2:41 p.m.: Who's winning the Par 3 Contest so far?With all the cute kids and extra putts and shots off tees, it's easy to forget there is an actual competition going on around all of it.While most players withdraw themselves by allowing a kid or girlfriend to it, some will play their ball through the entire nine holes.Aaron Rai is 5-under-par through eight holes and has the lead. Jacob Bridgeman is 4 under with a birdie putt on the ninth hole. 2:20 p.m.: Celebrity sightings with Bryson DeChambeau, Akshay BhatiaWhile there are plenty of young children on the course every year for the Par 3 Contest, there have been plenty of celebrities asked to be caddies as well.That group grows by one this year as comedian and actor Kevin Hart will be toting the bag for two-time U.S. Open winner Bryson DeChambeau this afternoon. They've just teed off No. 1.Meanwhile, former NFL offensive lineman Jason Kelce has taken over as the caddie for Akshay Bhatia, leaving the rising left-hander holding the mic as they walk the grounds.Kelce attempted to read a putt for Bhatia earlier, but it resulted in a miss. He's on site as a roving reporter for ESPN's coverage. 1:34 p.m.: Aces 2 and 3 at the Masters Par 3 ContestWhile several shots have been close at No. 6, it's No. 7 which brings the second ace of the day.Wyndham Clark's tee ball went 20 feet above the hole, then spun back into the cup. Group mates Keegan Bradley and Gary Woodland offered congratulations before handslaps with one of Bradley's children and a hug to his girlfriend.And on the very next hole, the same group strikes again ― this time it's Bradley who gets a hole-in-one on No. 8. 1:06 p.m.: Near aces, but no more holes in one at Par 3 ContestPlayers continue to roll through the Par 3 Course after an hour of play.We've had several near misses and No. 6 looks like a prime spot for another ace before the day is done: Sam Burns has the closest shot at 3 inches, but Bubba Watson and Justin Thomas also scared the hole with their tee shots.Mark O'Meara is also closest to the pin on No. 7. 12:36 p.m.: More players hit the Par 3 ContestWith the bevy of stars in the opening groups ― which includes Justin Thomas, Jordan Spieth and Scottie Scheffler ― ESPN did an early cut-in to the event, then kicked it back to ESPN+.Many players have taken themselves out of contention to win the event by letting a child hit one of their shots. They go down as a "NS" for "No Score" in the official results. 12:07 p.m.: First ace of the Masters Par 3 ContestWell, that didn't take long.In the first group of the day, Justin Thomas knocked in a hole-in-one on No. 2, alongside friends Jordan Spieth and Max Homa, and their host of children and wives. Can't wait to see the pictures of this one.What time is the 2026 Masters Par 3 Contest?The event is scheduled to start at noon Wednesday and run until approximately 4 p.m. at the Augusta National Golf Club Par 3 Course.How can I watch the 2026 Masters Par 3 Contest?Watch the Par 3 Contest on ESPN+The first two hours of the event are scheduled for ESPN Unlimited, with options also on Disney+. The action then moves to ESPN from 2-4 p.m. Fans can also stream action on Masters.com and the Masters app. What are the tee times for the 2026 Masters Par 3 Contest?In addition to any players in that year's Masters Tournament field, past champions can play.In all, 85 total players are in the Par 3 Contest, including 9 former champions, meaning 76 of the 91 players in the Masters field will appear today.11:53 a.m.: Justin Thomas, Jordan Spieth, Max HomaNoon: Ian Woosnam, Sam Burns, Scottie Scheffler12:07 p.m.: Sergio Garcia, Charl Schwartzel, Mark O'Meara12:14 p.m.: Adam Scott, Cameron Smith, Jose Maria Olazabal12:21 p.m.: Wyndham Clark, Keegan Bradley, gary Woodland12:28 p.m.: Bernhard Langer, Russell Henley, Larry Mize12:35 p.m.: Bubba Watson, Jason Day, Brandon Holtz.12:49 p.m.: Gary Player, Aldrich Potgeiter, Casey Jarvis12:56 p.m.: Ben Griffin, Andrew Novak, Davis Riley1:03 p.m.: Harry Hall, Nick Faldo, Naoyuki Kataoka1:10 p.m.: Jacob Bridgeman, Chris Gotterup, Akshay Bhatia1:17 p.m.: Angel Cabrera, Ben Crenshaw, Sandy Lyle1:24 p.m.: Patrick Reed, Aaron Rai, Jon Rahm1:38 p.m.: John Keefer, Maverick McNealy, Matt McCarty1:45 p.m.: Kurt Kitayama, Ryan Gerard, J.J. Spaun1:52 p.m.: Matthew Fitzpatrick, Ludvig Aberg, Vikto Hovland1:59 p.m.: Tom Watson, Ethan Fang, Mason Howell2:06 p.m.: Nicolas Echavarria, Min Woo Lee, Fifa Laopakdee2:13 p.m.: Bryson DeChambeau, Haotong Li, Sungjae Im2:27 p.m.: Danny Willett, Tyrrell Hatton, Dustin Johnson2:34 p.m.: Rasmus Neergaard-Petersen, Robert MacIntyre, Sami Valimaki2:41 p.m.: Jackson Herrington, Zach Johsnon, Mateo Pulcini2:48 p.m.: Sepp Straka, Brian Harman, Harris English2:55 p.m.: Rory McIlroy, Tommy Fleetwood, Shane Lowry.3:02 p.m.: Corey Conners, Nick Taylor, Ryan Fox3:16 p.m.: Tom McKibbin, Marco Penge, Kristoffer Reitan3:23 p.m.: Brian Campbell, Jake Knapp, Max Greyserman3:30 p.m.: Fred Couples, Brooks Koepka3:37 p.m.: Michael Brennan, Cameron Young, Sam Stevens3:44 p.m.: Si Woo Kim, Michael KimWhat are the rules for the Masters Par 3 Contest?Same as any golf tournament -- low score wins over the nine holes.Many players, however, have a wife, girlfriend or child putt for them, or hit off the tee on No. 9. By doing this, they are technically disqualified from "winning" the event.It is, however, said to be bad luck to win the Par 3 Contest. No player has ever won the Par 3 Contest and then the Masters Tournament in the same week.What is the history of the Par 3 Contest?The event started in 1960 and is played across the 1,090-yard Par 3 Course.There have been 115 holes in one, including three in 2025. The record score is 8-under-par 19, set by Jimmy Walker in 2016.
